name: BOOMBOX
description:
Featuring the new maxi-single “Alive”

Every time we sit down to write a press release for a Boombox tour, we end up reminiscing.

How many shows have we played? How much have we raised for Ukraine? Which new songs have we released? Those are the obvious things. Then we try to remember whether we’ve been to a particular country before - or if this is our very first time there.

We wish we could simply write: “Boombox live.” The way we did in Lviv, where 8,000 tickets disappeared in just 24 hours.

But that’s another story. This one is about Europe.

To everyone who’s made a home abroad - or is simply waiting for us somewhere across Europe-we’re happy to say that after our traditional short break, we’re hitting the road again.

And we’re bringing something brand new with us.

Our new maxi-single “Alive” - fresh as a summer watermelon from Kherson - alongside the songs that have been with us for years. Some of them became the soundtrack to your youth. Others are now growing up with your children.
